title: Hotels, Flying and Ships
intro: Hotel management, pilot, cabin crew, aircraft engineer and ship officer.

nodes.label: Airline cabin crew hiring
nodes.note: Class 12 pass, good English and Hindi, and the airline height and age rules. Airlines hire through interviews.

nodes.label: Aircraft engineer entry
nodes.note: Class 12 with PCM, or an engineering diploma after Class 10. Join a DGCA-approved college.

nodes.label: BSc Hospitality (3 years)
nodes.note: At Institutes of Hotel Management, for example IHM Bangalore.

nodes.label: Pilot training (CPL)
nodes.note: Ground exams and flying hours. A Class 1 medical is needed.

nodes.label: Cabin crew course
nodes.note: A short course on service, safety and grooming.

nodes.label: Aircraft Maintenance Engineering
nodes.note: Train to look after aircraft.

nodes.label: BSc Nautical Science or BTech Marine
nodes.note: 3 to 4 years at the Indian Maritime University and similar colleges.

nodes.label: Hotel manager or chef
nodes.note: Run hotels, kitchens and events.

nodes.label: Commercial pilot
nodes.note: Fly airline and charter aircraft.

nodes.label: Cabin crew
nodes.note: Look after passengers in the air.

nodes.label: Aircraft engineer
nodes.note: Keep aircraft safe and flying.

nodes.label: Ship officer
nodes.note: Deck or engine officer on a merchant ship.

nodes.label: Chef
nodes.note: Cook and lead a kitchen.

nodes.label: Front office manager
nodes.note: Welcome guests at a hotel.

nodes.label: Event planner
nodes.note: Plan weddings and events.

nodes.label: Travel and tour manager
nodes.note: Plan trips for others.

nodes.label: Restaurant owner
nodes.note: Start your own restaurant or cafe.

nodes.label: Cruise ship hospitality officer
nodes.note: Work in hotels at sea.

nodes.label: Cargo pilot
nodes.note: Fly goods around the world.

nodes.label: Flight instructor
nodes.note: Teach new pilots.

nodes.label: Air traffic control training
nodes.note: Graduates in science or engineering can join the Airports Authority of India. Check its notice.

nodes.label: Air traffic controller
nodes.note: Guide aircraft safely in the sky and on the ground.

nodes.label: Airport ground staff
nodes.note: Check in passengers and handle bags.

nodes.label: Airport operations officer
nodes.note: Keep an airport running on time.

nodes.label: Ship captain
nodes.note: Lead a ship and its crew.

nodes.label: Port manager
nodes.note: Run the work at a seaport.

nodes.label: Marine surveyor
nodes.note: Inspect ships for safety.

nodes.label: Restaurant steward or waiter
nodes.note: Serve guests in restaurants and hotels.

nodes.label: Bell captain and guest services
nodes.note: Help hotel guests with luggage and needs.
